responsibility: Implementation of RTL SSA instruction objects, notes, and instruction-level dataflow bookkeeping. This file computes and prints insn_info metadata, maintains linked lists of instruction notes and call-clobber annotations, records accesses and costs while building SSA, and supplies dump/debug helpers for instructions and their associated access summaries.
same_name_distinction: Implements the behavior of instruction objects declared in insns.h, including cost computation, note attachment, ordering comparisons, full instruction printing, access recording during SSA build, call-clobber note creation, and dump helpers; unlike insns.h, it supplies the executable bookkeeping and builder logic for instruction metadata.
